related.title: Roofline 經典：運算強度與可達性能
related.titleEn: The Roofline model: intensity and attainable performance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：界與標準差不混淆，範圍和縮放清楚，驗證涵蓋中點及滿刻度附近。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Bounds and standard deviations stay distinct; range/scaling are explicit and midpoint/endpoints tested.
related.difference: 以實際階層流量定義強度，判斷頻寬或計算限制，避免混用峰值及可持續頻寬。
related.differenceEn: Define intensity at one memory hierarchy and distinguish bandwidth from compute limits.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學均勻ADC步距Δ=FS/2^b，最近捨入界Δ/2；已知最壞偏差可保守相加。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 FS=1 V、b=8，類比漂移界1 mV；忽略失調、熱雜訊與飽和。 總界=1000/(2×2^8)+1=2.953125 mV。這是保守界，不是標準差。
P≤min(Ppeak,B×I)，I=FLOP/byte；同一圖上的頻寬與流量必須對應同一階層。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學Ppeak=100 TFLOP/s，可持續B=2 TB/s，I=20 FLOP/byte。 頻寬界2×20=40 TFLOP/s，小於100，因此上界40。轉折強度100/2=50 FLOP/byte。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching uniform ADC spacing is FS/2^b, with nearest-rounding boundΔ/2; bounded worst-case biases add conservatively. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. FS=1 V, b=8, analog drift bound1 mV; ignore offset, thermal noise and saturation. Total bound=1000/(2×2^8)+1=2.953125 mV, a worst-case bound rather than standard deviation.

P≤min(Ppeak, BI), with I in FLOP/byte; bandwidth and traffic must refer to one hierarchy. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching peak100 TFLOP/s, sustained bandwidth2 TB/s, intensity 20 FLOP/byte. Bandwidth ceiling2×20=40 TFLOP/s below100; ridge intensity=100/2=50 FLOP/byte.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Megatron 張量平行：分片收益與通訊成本
related.titleEn: Megatron tensor parallelism: shards and communication
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：界與標準差不混淆，範圍和縮放清楚，驗證涵蓋中點及滿刻度附近。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Bounds and standard deviations stay distinct; range/scaling are explicit and midpoint/endpoints tested.
related.difference: 在減少單卡計算的同時加上必要collective，判斷平行度提高是否仍有收益。
related.differenceEn: Add required collectives to reduced per-device compute and evaluate increasing parallelism.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

簡化層時間T=C/p+K，p為平行度、K為量測或假設的collective時間，不能忽略K。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 單卡C=16 ms；p4時collective2 ms；p8時collective3 ms，無重疊。 p4時間16/4+2=6 ms，速度比16/6=2.6667，非4倍。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching uniform ADC spacing is FS/2^b, with nearest-rounding boundΔ/2; bounded worst-case biases add conservatively. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. FS=1 V, b=8, analog drift bound1 mV; ignore offset, thermal noise and saturation. Total bound=1000/(2×2^8)+1=2.953125 mV, a worst-case bound rather than standard deviation.

Single-deviceC16 ms; collective2 ms atp4 and 3 ms atp8, without overlap. Atp4, time=6 ms, speedup2.6667 rather than4.
